scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/write-sitemap-alias.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint src scripts astro.config.mjs content.config.ts postcss.config.js vitest.config.ts --type-aware
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint src scripts astro.config.mjs content.config.ts postcss.config.js vitest.config.ts --fix
scripts.format: oxfmt --write "src/**/*.{astro,ts,tsx,js,jsx,css}" "scripts/*.mjs" astro.config.mjs content.config.ts postcss.config.js vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json cloudflare.config.ts wrangler.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check "src/**/*.{astro,ts,tsx,js,jsx,css}" "scripts/*.mjs" astro.config.mjs content.config.ts postcss.config.js vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json cloudflare.config.ts wrangler.config.ts
scripts.fonts: astro build && node scripts/write-sitemap-alias.mjs && node scripts/build-web-fonts.mjs && oxfmt --write src/fonts/web-fonts.css
scripts.deploy:cf: pnpm build && cf-wrangler build && cf deploy --prebuilt
